name: Sheriff
body:
You are the law.

Prerequisite(s): Order of the lion; Leadership

Benefit: You gain all the rights and privileges of the chief law enforcer of your lord’s domain, including the ability to violate those laws in the service of the Greater good. You are answerable only to your sovereign for your actions. In addition, your cohorts and followers (gained from the Leadership feat) are your posse and are similarly deputized to enforce the law.
